items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: You see, after he died, then Alton LeBlanc come in.

ctx.x: Now Marlon Gibson, where did he play? Clarinet and saxophone? Clarinet and saxophone. Which sax? Alto or tenor?

You see, he was in that band before he had the tenor. That was before Alton LeBlanc. Mm-hmm. I see. You see, after he died, then Alton LeBlanc come in. Have any alto players or baritone players? Yeah, they had, they had, on the alto they had, this man I called from out of the Poetry Innville. You say he taught, he taught Jim Robinson. Ernest Hines. Ernest Hines was on the alto side of the phone. Yeah. You see, George was too small then. They had George Williams, the son, they had him along with him on the C…

Did you ever see Billy Kersams? That's before my time. Yeah. I heard of Billy Kersams and Black Patty, but I... Yeah, I heard about him from playing up there from somebody. Maybe Charlie Love or somebody told me about him. That's way before my time. It's so, it's so hard to keep all that straight, all those guys. Well, I guess that just about covers Clarinet Williams except...
